contamination_risks: All prior scanner, catalyst, v3 qualification, multi-strategy, production-aware, and reversal target dates and outcomes are inspected ancestors and must be excluded from development and confirmation.
The retest mechanism is motivated only by pre-outcome deployability failure; no failed-v3 post-entry price or return may be accessed during design or collection.
Symbol, date, provider, missing-input, and fill substitutions are forbidden; unavailable rows remain explicit denominator failures.
The complete one-trial family and all no-trade days must be published; post-result threshold or cohort selection retires this exact challenger.
entry_rule: After a condition-valid first trade through the 09:30-09:35 opening-range high, do not enter. Before 10:30 ET, take the first fully completed one-minute bar whose low touches or crosses that high and whose close is at or above it while exact SIP VWAP is flat-to-rising. Enter on the first condition-valid trade above that retest bar high, using a marketable limit no more than 0.15% above the rebreak trigger, only after three fresh quote/book snapshots pass the unchanged A+ spread, depth, liquidity, halt, market, and catalyst gates.

execution_assumptions.entry_fill: first executable observed ask at or below marketable limit after the rebreak decision snapshot

exit_rule: Require at least 2.5R and 2.2% room before resistance after costs. Exit at the +2% milestone unless the unchanged frozen runner contract qualifies; resolve same-interval stop/target ambiguity stop-first, use the worse of stop and opening gap plus reserve, and force flat by 15:50 ET.
expected_holding_behavior: Observe the initial five-minute ORB without entering, require the first completed one-minute retest bar to touch the opening-range high and close at or above it, then enter only the first condition-valid rebreak before 10:30 ET and remain flat by 15:50 ET.
material_difference_rationale: This changes the causal entry mechanism from buying the first opening-range break to requiring observed breakout acceptance through a completed retest and rebreak. It does not relax v3 thresholds, compress stops, reuse failed-corpus outcomes, or alter portfolio, risk, protection, session, or overnight constraints.
mechanism: A source-verified catalyst breakout that retests and holds the opening-range high before rebreaking represents accepted price discovery rather than the transient first-break impulse, improving executable persistence after costs.
production_compatibility_risks: Retest frequency may be too low to reach 50 eligible development signals on disjoint data.
The later trigger may worsen resistance room or miss the +2% path even if it improves first-break persistence.
A structural retest stop may exceed the unchanged 0.8% cap; such signals must be rejected rather than compressed.
Subminute SIP trades, three fresh quote/book snapshots, visible depth, protection timing, and broker tradability remain required before any prospective shadow or live use.
ranking_rule: On simultaneous signals, rank exact opening relative volume first, direct catalyst quality second, median spread third, and stable private pair identity last; rank scope and universe completeness must be retained.
selection_rule: At most one selected trade per requested date and one open position; preserve every no-trade, missed-fill, unavailable, and rejected session in denominators.
stop_rule: Set structural invalidation below the retest-bar low and ordinary noise, then use max(0.10 times prior-completed-session ATR(14), entry minus technical invalidation). Reject rather than compress when the stop exceeds 0.8%, is not below every observed bid, violates the configured maturity risk cap, or cannot be protected promptly.
